header: Example reviews from three TYPO3 teams

reviewer_image.title: Portrait of Sofia Berg
reviewer_image.alternative: A woman in her forties with shoulder-length ash-blonde hair and a charcoal sweater.

reviews.title: Studio covered its cost on the first project
reviews.review_text: We started free, then chose Studio at €590 a year for the maintenance promise. The first upgrade took one afternoon, which covered a year of fees.

reviewer_image.title: Portrait of Daniel Okafor
reviewer_image.alternative: A man with dark skin, very short hair and a short beard, wearing a navy blazer.

reviews.title: The €1,490 Kickstart was worth it
reviews.review_text: In one session the maintainers showed our developers the styleguide, themes and seeder. With a backend preview for all 244 elements, training our 12 editors took an afternoon.

reviewer_image.title: Portrait of Mei-Ling Tan
reviewer_image.alternative: A woman with a sleek black bob, a navy blazer and a white T-shirt.

reviews.title: Custom elements that match the rest
reviews.review_text: We ordered two custom elements at €890 each, and they look like the other 244. One filter list needed size M at €1,690, which we had not budgeted.
